interface.longDescription: Create, edit, redline, and comment on `.docx`, Word, and Google Docs-targeted document artifacts inside the container, with a strict render-and-verify workflow. Use `render_docx.py` to generate page PNGs (and optional PDF) for visual QA, then iterate until layout is flawless before delivering the final document.
